title: The Collectives SMP Modpack
description: Collectives SMP Modpack for a few friends and whoever may want it :)
body:
This modpack features the create mod, plenty of food mods and building mods. A rule for you if you like, _don't use the Infinte Ham, or the eternal steak/beef or the other relics like those._ Theres LOADS of foods to make; I feel its plenty to satisfy your eternal hunger! :P 

Some content has been removed because of lack of permission or denial of permission to reupload them to Modrinth. The pack works without them, its just feature loss that I felt should be said :) In this case, I recommend going to curseforge and looking at [Corail Tombstone](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/corail-tombstone), its feature packed and a mod that we use on our personal server. I highly recommend if you want to play without keep inventory, but not loose your things every time you die in game. 

_**If putting directly in a server, some mods like Oculus, Embeddium and Ears+ (to my knowledge) may have to be removed server side to function or run properly.**_

This modpack does take a second to load the game up. I recommend at least 6000mb allocated to this profile before trying to run it. I personally use 8512mb or at least 8.5 of Ram to run all my modpacks smoothly, with not much lagging.

### **CREDIT WHERE CREDIT IS DUE:**

Some specific content included:
- [Create recycle Everything](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-recycle-everything)
- [Dynamic lights](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tschipcrafts-dynamic-lights-mod)
- [Fresh Animations](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/fresh-animations)
- [Aqua Culture Delight](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/aquaculture-delight)

_ALL CONTENT IN THIS PACK DOES NOT BELONG TO ME OR MY CREW!! This lovely bunch of content is owned by their respective creators and they deserve all credit. I simply gathered them in one big bundle :)_

We upload our vods to our [Crew Youtube!](https://www.youtube.com/@TheImmortalCouncil) _Language and Obscenity warning_ ;) Check out The Collectives SMP videos for a playthrough of this pack!

Thank you for checking out our pack!
